summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py, exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and documented it in docs/source/losses.rst. Constructor takes a square non-negative distance_matrix plus include_background, to_onehot_y, sigmoid, softmax, and reduction. The loss is a class-weighted (inverse-squared volume) expected Wasserstein cost normalized by max(M). This is my own formulation, not a verified port of Fidon et al. (2017), so it should be checked against the paper and issue #601. Nothing was run, no unit test file was added, and nothing was committed.
